```{r load}
lymphoma_data <- read_rds(paste0(here::here(), 
                            "/data/processed data",
                            "/LymphomaObesity_Data_20260629.rds")) %>% 
  select(-ch_status)
path <- fs::path("", "Volumes", "Gillis_Research",
                 "Lab_Data", "LymphomaObesity")
sample_list <- 
  readxl::read_xlsx(paste0(# path,
    here::here(), "/data/raw data",
    "/Lymphoma_Shipping Manifest_EXP2052DNA_PHI_20240504.xlsx"), 
    sheet = "Shipping Manifest_w PHI") %>% 
  janitor::clean_names()
ch_mutation <- 
  readxl::read_xlsx(paste0(# path,
    here::here(), "/data/raw data",
    "/Lymphoma_CHcalls_20260417.xlsx"), 
    na = "NA") %>% 
  janitor::clean_names()

drug_dat <- 
  readxl::read_xlsx(paste0(# path,
    here::here(), "/data/raw data",
    "/Lymphoma_DrugDataEHR_20260701.xlsx"), na = "NA") %>% 
  janitor::clean_names() %>% 
  filter(is.na(exclude)) %>% 
  select(mrn, regimen, regimen_start = start, regimen_stop = stop, 
         progression_date = progression, last_prog_fu, notes)

ipi_dat <- 
  readxl::read_xls(paste0(# path,
    here::here(), "/data/raw data",
    "/Lymphoma_IPIReviewed_20261023.xls")) %>% 
  janitor::clean_names() |> 
  select(mrn, ipi_score, ipi_cat = group) |> 
  mutate(mrn = as.character(mrn))

```

```{r}
lymphoma_data <- lymphoma_data %>% 
  mutate(age_sq = age_at_diagnosis_num^2) |> 
  mutate(race = factor(race, levels = c("White", "Other"))) %>% 
  mutate(ethnicity_src_desc = na_if(ethnicity_src_desc, "UNKNOWN")) |> 
  mutate(ethnicity_src_desc = case_when(
    is.na(ethnicity_src_desc)            ~ "SPANISH NOS",
    TRUE                                 ~ ethnicity_src_desc
  )) %>% 
  mutate(year_at_dx = year(dx_dt)) %>% 
  mutate(year_at_dx_cat = case_when(
    year_at_dx >= 2011 &
      year_at_dx <= 2017                  ~ "2011-2017",
    year_at_dx >= 2018 &
      year_at_dx <= 2022                  ~ "2018-2022",
    TRUE                                  ~ as.character(year_at_dx)
  )) %>% 
  left_join(., ipi_dat, by = "mrn") |>
  mutate(ipi_score = factor(ipi_score)) %>% 
  mutate(ipi_cat_ekram = str_to_title(ipi_cat)) |> 
  mutate(ipi_cat_ekram = factor(ipi_cat_ekram, levels = c("Low", "Low Intermediate", "High Intermediate", "High"))) %>% 
  mutate(ipi_cat = case_when(
    ipi_score == 1                        ~ "Low",
    ipi_score == 2                        ~ "Low Intermediate",
    ipi_score == 3                        ~ "High Intermediate",
    ipi_score == 4                        ~ "High",
    ipi_score == 5                        ~ "High"
  )) |> 
  mutate(ipi_cat = factor(ipi_cat, levels = c("Low", "Low Intermediate", "High Intermediate", "High"))) %>% 
  mutate(ipi_cat2 = case_when(
    str_detect(ipi_cat, "Low")                       ~ "Low",
    str_detect(ipi_cat, "High")                      ~ "High"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(ipi_cat2 = factor(ipi_cat2, levels = c("Low", "High"))) %>% 
  mutate(stage1 = case_when(
    str_detect(stage_tnm_cs_mixed_group_desc, "1")   ~ "I",
    str_detect(stage_tnm_cs_mixed_group_desc, "2")   ~ "II",
    str_detect(stage_tnm_cs_mixed_group_desc, "3")   ~ "III",
    str_detect(stage_tnm_cs_mixed_group_desc, "4")   ~ "IV"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(stage = case_when(
    stage1 %in% c("I", "II")              ~ "I-II",
    stage1 %in% c("III", "IV")            ~ "III-IV"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(stage2 = case_when(
    stage1 %in% c("I", "II", "III")       ~ "I-III",
    stage1 %in% c("IV")                   ~ "IV"
  )) %>% 
  left_join(., drug_dat %>% 
              mutate(mrn = as.character(mrn)),
            by = "mrn") %>% 
  mutate(progression_date = as.Date(as.numeric(progression_date), origin = "1899-12-30")) %>% 
  mutate(pfs_event = case_when(
    !is.na(progression_date)         ~ 1,
    os_event == 1                    ~ 1,
    os_event == 0                    ~ 0
  )) %>% 
  mutate(pfs_date = case_when(
    !is.na(progression_date)         ~ progression_date,
    os_event == 1                    ~ last_prog_fu,
    os_event == 0                    ~ last_prog_fu
  )) %>% 
  mutate(pfs_time_from_treatment_months = interval(start = regimen_start, end = pfs_date) /
           duration(n=1, unit = "months")) %>% 
  
  # select(mrn, progression_date, pfs_event, pfs_date, pfs_time_from_treatment_months, os_event, os_time_from_treatment_months,
  #        date_of_last_contact, last_prog_fu, notes) %>% 
  # mutate(last_prog_fu == date_of_last_contact)
  
  mutate(regimen_cat = case_when(
    str_detect(regimen, "CHOP")        ~ "R-CHOP",
    str_detect(regimen, "EPOCH")       ~ "DA-EPOCH-R"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(time_sample_first_treatment = interval(start = first_treatment_dt, end = collection_dt_germline) /
           duration(n=1, unit = "days")) #%>% 
  # select(mrn, first_treatment_dt, collection_dt_germline)

lymphoma_data <- lymphoma_data %>% 
  # Index
  mutate(across(c(ends_with("_cm2")
                  ), ~ . / (height_m ^2), 
                .names = "{.col}_index")) %>% 
  rename(smi = muscle_cm2_index) %>% 
  # Sarcopenia
  mutate(sarcopenia = case_when(
    sex == "Female" &
      smi >= 38.5                         ~ "≥ cutoff",
    sex == "Female" &
      smi < 38.5                          ~ "Sarcopenia",
    sex == "Male" &
      smi >= 52.4                         ~ "≥ cutoff",
    sex == "Male" &
      smi < 52.4                          ~ "Sarcopenia"
  )) %>%
  # Myosteatosis - skeletal muscle fat infiltration
  mutate(myosteatosis = case_when(
    bmi < 25 &
      muscle_hu < 41                      ~ "Myosteatosis",
    bmi >= 25 &
      muscle_hu < 33                      ~ "Myosteatosis",
    !is.na(muscle_hu) &
      !is.na(bmi)                         ~ "No myosteatosis"
  ), myosteatosis = factor(myosteatosis, levels = c("No myosteatosis", "Myosteatosis"))) %>%
  # TAT
  mutate(tat_cm2 = case_when(
    is.na(vat_cm2) |
    is.na(sat_cm2) |
    is.na(imat_cm2)                       ~ NA_real_,
    TRUE                                  ~ vat_cm2 + sat_cm2 + imat_cm2
  )) %>% 
  mutate(tat_cm2_index = case_when(
    is.na(vat_cm2_index) |
    is.na(sat_cm2_index) |
    is.na(imat_cm2_index)                 ~ NA_real_,
    TRUE                                  ~ vat_cm2_index + sat_cm2_index + imat_cm2_index
  )) %>% 
  # V/S ratio
  mutate(v_s_ratio = vat_cm2 / sat_cm2) %>% 
  mutate(visceral_obesity = case_when(
    v_s_ratio > 0.4                       ~ "Viscerally obese",
    !is.na(v_s_ratio)                     ~ "Not viscerally obese"
  )) %>% 
  # Proportion - remove the values if one feature is NA
  mutate(muscle_proportion = muscle_cm2 / 
           (muscle_cm2 + vat_cm2 +
              sat_cm2 + imat_cm2)) %>% 
  mutate(vat_proportion = vat_cm2 / 
           (muscle_cm2 + vat_cm2 +
              sat_cm2 + imat_cm2)) %>% 
  mutate(sat_proportion = sat_cm2 / 
           (muscle_cm2 + vat_cm2 +
              sat_cm2 + imat_cm2)) %>% 
  mutate(imat_proportion = imat_cm2 / 
           (muscle_cm2 + vat_cm2 +
              sat_cm2 + imat_cm2)) %>% 
  # mutate(muscle_proportionindex = smi / 
  #          (smi + vat_cm2_index +
  #             sat_cm2_index + imat_cm2_index)) %>% 
  # mutate(vat_proportionindex = vat_cm2_index / 
  #          (smi + vat_cm2_index +
  #             sat_cm2_index + imat_cm2_index)) %>% 
  # mutate(sat_proportionindex = sat_cm2_index / 
  #          (smi + vat_cm2_index +
  #             sat_cm2_index + imat_cm2_index)) %>% 
  # mutate(imat_proportionindex = imat_cm2_index / 
  #          (smi + vat_cm2_index +
  #             sat_cm2_index + imat_cm2_index)) %>% 
  mutate(across(c(contains("_proportion")), ~ case_when(
    is.na(muscle_cm2) |
    is.na(vat_cm2) |
    is.na(sat_cm2) |
    is.na(imat_cm2)                    ~ NA_real_,
    TRUE                               ~ .
  )))

lymphoma_data <- lymphoma_data %>% 
  # Make categorical var
  mutate(across(c(smi, ends_with("_index"),
                  "muscle_hu",
                  "vat_cm2", "sat_cm2", "imat_cm2",
                  "tat_cm2",
                  "v_s_ratio",
                  contains("_proportion")
                  ), ~ case_when(
    ntile(., 3) == 1 ~ "Low",
    ntile(., 3) == 2 ~ "Medium",
    ntile(., 3) == 3 ~ "High"),
    .names = "{.col}_tertcat")) %>% 
  mutate(across(c(ends_with("_tertcat")), 
                ~ factor(., levels = 
                           c("Low", "Medium", "High"))))
```

```{r}
ch_mutation <- ch_mutation %>% 
  inner_join(sample_list %>%
              select(source_sample_id, mrn) %>%
              distinct(), .,
            by = "source_sample_id") %>%
  mutate(mrn = as.character(mrn)) %>%
  mutate(patient_l_ch = case_when(
    l_ch == "TRUE"                     ~ "L-CH"
  )) %>% 
  group_by(mrn) %>%
  mutate(number_of_mutation_per_patient = case_when(
    is.na(gene)                        ~ NA_real_,
    TRUE                               ~ n()
  )) %>% 
  fill(patient_l_ch, .direction = "updown") %>% 
  ungroup()

library(fastDummies)
ch_mutation1 <- ch_mutation %>% 
  filter(!is.na(gene)) %>% 
  select(mrn, number_of_mutation_per_patient, gene, variant_p) %>% 
  unite(mutation_variant, c(gene, variant_p)) %>%
  distinct()

mutation_variant_wide <- dummy_cols(.data = ch_mutation1, select_columns = "mutation_variant",
                                    remove_selected_columns = TRUE,
                                    omit_colname_prefix = FALSE, ignore_na = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(mrn, number_of_mutation_per_patient) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), sum)) %>%
  ungroup()

ch_mutation1 <- ch_mutation %>% 
  filter(!is.na(gene)) %>% 
  select(mrn, mutation_gene = gene) %>% 
  distinct()

mutation_gene_wide <- dummy_cols(.data = ch_mutation1, select_columns = "mutation_gene",
                                    remove_selected_columns = TRUE,
                                    omit_colname_prefix = FALSE, ignore_na = TRUE) %>%
  group_by(mrn) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), sum)) %>%
  ungroup()

lymphoma_data <- lymphoma_data %>%
  inner_join(., ch_mutation %>% 
               select(mrn, ch_status, patient_l_ch) %>% 
               distinct(), 
             by = "mrn") %>%
  full_join(., mutation_variant_wide, by = "mrn") %>%
  full_join(., mutation_gene_wide, by = "mrn") %>%
  mutate(across(c(starts_with("mutation_variant") | 
                    starts_with("mutation_gene")
                  ), .fns = ~ replace_na(., 0))) %>% 
  mutate(ch_status = factor(ch_status, levels = c("No CH", "CH")))
```

# I. Correlation of CH with age
```{r}
lymphoma_data %>%
  select(age_at_diagnosis_num,
         age_sq,
         ch_status
         ) %>%
  tbl_summary(by = ch_status,
              statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ 
                                 "{median} [{min}-{max}]"),
              digits = list(all_continuous() ~ 1)) %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  add_p() %>% bold_p(t = 0.05) %>% add_overall() %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "**Patient characteristics**",
                all_stat_cols() ~ "**{level}**, N = {n}")
```

## Age
```{r}
glm(ch_status ~
      age_at_diagnosis_num,
    family = "binomial",
    data = lymphoma_data) %>%
  tbl_regression(exponentiate = TRUE
                 ) %>%
  add_n() |> add_nevent() |> 
  modify_spanning_header(everything() ~ "Regression for CH status")
lymphoma_data |> 
  select(ch_status, age_at_diagnosis_num) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = ch_status, y = age_at_diagnosis_num))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_jitter()+
  stat_compare_means(method = "wilcox.test", label = "p.format" )
```

```{r}
vaf_reg_dat <- ch_mutation %>% 
  filter(!is.na(vaf)) %>%
  select(mrn, vaf) %>% 
  arrange(mrn, desc(vaf)) %>% 
  # distinct(mrn, .keep_all = TRUE) |> 
  mutate(log2_vaf = log2(vaf)) %>% 
  mutate(vaf_cat = case_when(
    vaf >= 0.10           ~ 1,
    vaf < 0.10            ~ 0
  )) %>% 
  full_join(lymphoma_data, 
            ., 
            by = "mrn") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(vaf))

vaf_reg_dat |> 
  select(vaf, log2_vaf, age_at_diagnosis_num) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = age_at_diagnosis_num, y = log2_vaf))+
  geom_point()+
  # xlim(15, 50)+
  labs(x = "Age", y = "VAF (log2)")+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black") +
  stat_cor(aes(label = paste(..rr.label.., ..p.label.., sep = "~`,`~")), 
           # label.x = 4.5#, 
           label.y = -2.5
           )

glm(log2_vaf ~
      age_at_diagnosis_num,
    data = vaf_reg_dat) %>%
  tbl_regression(exponentiate = FALSE
) %>%
  modify_table_body(
    ~ .x %>%
      mutate(
        estimate = 2^estimate,
        conf.low = 2^conf.low,
        conf.high = 2^conf.high
      )
  ) |> 
  modify_spanning_header(everything() ~ "Regression for continuous CH log2(VAF) - result = VAF ratio or 2^β^")
```

# II. The authors should report PFS and OS of the DLBCL cohort and more granularity about treatment received.

## OS
Median OS in months
```{r}
survfit(Surv(time = lymphoma_data$os_time_from_treatment_months,
                   event = lymphoma_data$os_event) ~ 1,
              data = lymphoma_data) %>%
  tbl_survfit(
    probs = 0.5,
    label_header = "**Median survival (95% CI)**"
  ) %>% add_nevent() %>% add_n()
survfit(Surv(time = lymphoma_data$os_time_from_treatment_months,
                   event = lymphoma_data$os_event) ~ ch_status,
              data = lymphoma_data) %>%
  tbl_survfit(
    probs = 0.5,
    label_header = "**Median survival (95% CI)**"
  ) %>% add_nevent() %>% add_n()
```

```{r KM OS by CH}
ggsurvplot(survfit(Surv(os_time_from_treatment_months, os_event) ~ ch_status,
                   data = lymphoma_data),
           # title = "PFS Analysis",
           font.main = c(20, "bold", "black"),
           font.x = c(18, "bold", "black"),
           font.y = c(18, "bold", "black"),
           font.legend = c(16, "black"),
           font.tickslab = c(16, "bold", "black"),
           size = 1.5,

           xlab = "Time (months)",
           legend = "top",
           pval = TRUE,
           conf.int = FALSE,
           # Censor
           censor = TRUE
) %++% guides(colour = guide_legend(ncol = 1))
```

## PFS
Median PFS in months
```{r}
survfit(Surv(time = lymphoma_data$pfs_time_from_treatment_months,
                   event = lymphoma_data$pfs_event) ~ 1,
              data = lymphoma_data) %>%
  tbl_survfit(
    probs = 0.5,
    label_header = "**Median PFS (95% CI)**"
  ) %>% add_nevent() %>% add_n()
survfit(Surv(time = lymphoma_data$pfs_time_from_treatment_months,
                   event = lymphoma_data$pfs_event) ~ ch_status,
              data = lymphoma_data) %>%
  tbl_survfit(
    probs = 0.5,
    label_header = "**Median PFS (95% CI)**"
  ) %>% add_nevent() %>% add_n()
```

```{r KM PFS by CH pfs}
ggsurvplot(survfit(Surv(pfs_time_from_treatment_months, pfs_event) ~ ch_status,
                   data = lymphoma_data),
           title = "PFS Analysis",
```

# Stage and IPI
## Stage
## Univariable
```{r HR uva cox clinical}
lymphoma_data <- lymphoma_data |> 
  mutate(ipi_num = as.numeric(ipi_score)) |> 
  mutate(stage_inv = factor(stage1, levels = c("IV", "III", "II", "I"))) |> 
  mutate(stage2_inv = factor(stage2, levels = c("IV", "I-III"))) |> 
  mutate(ipi_cat_inv = factor(ipi_cat, levels = c("High", "High Intermediate", "Low Intermediate", "Low")))

tbl_uvregression(
  lymphoma_data,
  method = coxph,
  y = Surv(time = os_time_from_treatment_months, event = os_event),
  exponentiate = TRUE,
  include = c("stage", "stage1", "stage_inv", "stage2", "stage2_inv")) %>%
  bold_p(t = .05) %>%
  add_nevent(location = "level") %>% add_n(location = "level") %>%
  bold_labels() %>% italicize_levels()
```

```{r}
lymphoma_data %>%
  select(age_at_diagnosis_num, 
         year_at_dx_cat,
         sex, 
         race, 
         ethnicity_src_desc,
         stage1,
         bmi, bmi_cat,
         `survival time (months, Registry)` = survival_time_in_months,
         os_time_from_treatment_months, os_event,
         pfs_event,
         ch_status
         ) %>%
  tbl_summary(by = stage1,
              digits = list(all_continuous() ~ 1)) %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  add_p() %>% bold_p(t = 0.05) %>% add_overall() %>% 
  modify_header(label ~ "**Patient characteristics**",
                all_stat_cols() ~ "**{level}**, N = {n}")
```
Stage II patients :

- are older but diagnosed more recently   
- are more likely represented in the intermediate BMI category   
- are more likely to experience death   
- are more likely to be No CH

I added 24 models into the multiple comparison adjustment. The resulting p value are presented below.   
The models with the prefix `CH_` are for the CH status outcome, `DNMT3A/PPM1D/TET_` for the CHgene outcome.
The suffix is the predictor included.   
All these models are adjusted by age + sex + stage.
```{r}

models <- list(
    CH_SMI  = tbl_ch_muscle_ind_mva,
    CH_VATI  = tbl_ch_vat_ind_mva,
    CH_SATI  = tbl_ch_sat_ind_mva,
    CH_IMATI = tbl_ch_imat_ind_mva,
    DNMT3A_SMI  = tbl_dnmt3a_muscle_ind_mva,
    DNMT3A_VATI  = tbl_dnmt3a_vat_ind_mva,
    DNMT3A_SATI  = tbl_dnmt3a_sat_ind_mva,
    DNMT3A_IMATI = tbl_dnmt3a_imat_ind_mva,
    PPM1D_SMI  = tbl_ppm1d_muscle_ind_mva,
    PPM1D_VATI = tbl_ppm1d_vat_ind_mva,
    PPM1D_SATI  = tbl_ppm1d_sat_ind_mva,
    PPM1D_IMATI = tbl_ppm1d_imat_ind_mva,
    TET_SMI  = tbl_tet2_muscle_ind_mva,
    TET_VATI = tbl_tet2_vat_ind_mva,
    TET_SATI  = tbl_tet2_sat_ind_mva,
    TET_IMATI = tbl_tet2_imat_ind_mva
)

exposure_terms <- c(
  smi_sdhr  = "SMI",
  vat_cm2_index_sdhr  = "VATI",
  sat_cm2_index_sdhr  = "SATI",
  imat_cm2_index_sdhr = "IMATI"
)

# results <- 
  imap_dfr(models, function(model, exposure) {
  broom::tidy(model) |>
    filter(term %in% c(names(exposure_terms))) |>
    transmute(
      exposure = exposure,
      estimate = estimate,
      p_value = p.value
    )
}) |>
  mutate(
    OR = exp(estimate),
    p_adjusted = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  )
```
